meta.name: influence-psychology
meta.description: Apply the seven principles of ethical persuasion (reciprocity, commitment, social proof, authority, liking, scarcity, unity) to product design, copy, and sales. Use when the user mentions "social proof", "persuasive copy", "why users dont convert", "ethical persuasion", "reciprocity", "scarcity tactics", "commitment and consistency", "shared identity", "in-group", "make my copy more persuasive", "increase trust", or "get more people to say yes". Also trigger when designing testimonial sections, crafting urgency messaging, or improving trust signals on landing pages. Covers the principles, when each applies, and ethical limits. For deal negotiation tactics, see negotiation. For viral word-of-mouth, see contagious.

copy.tagline: 用七大说服原则提升转化与信任
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让产品文案和页面更有说服力
copy.tagline_en: Boost conversions and trust with seven persuasion principles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to make your product copy and pages more persuasive

howto.what: Claude 会运用互惠、承诺一致、社会认同、权威、喜好、稀缺、团结七项原则，帮你优化产品设计、文案和销售，并给出伦理边界提醒。
howto.when: 当你提到“社会认同”、“稀缺策略”、“让文案更有说服力”等关键词，或设计推荐区、紧迫感信息、信任信号时触发。

say.text: 帮我用社会认同原则重写这个推荐区。
say.note: Claude 会应用社会认同的多种类型和文案模式。

say.text: 这个落地页的稀缺信息怎么加才真实？
say.note: Claude 会给出符合伦理的稀缺策略和示例。

say.text: 用互惠原则设计一个免费试用流程。
say.note: Claude 会提供互惠触发点和文案建议。

howto.what_en: Claude applies the seven principles of ethical persuasion (reciprocity, commitment, social proof, authority, liking, scarcity, unity) to product design, copy, and sales, and flags ethical boundaries.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "social proof", "scarcity tactics", "make my copy more persuasive", or when designing testimonial sections, urgency messaging, or trust signals.

say_en.text: Rewrite this testimonial section using social proof.
say_en.note: Claude applies social proof types and copy patterns.

say_en.text: How can I add scarcity to this landing page ethically?
say_en.note: Claude gives ethical scarcity strategies and examples.

say_en.text: Design a free trial flow using reciprocity.
say_en.note: Claude provides reciprocity triggers and copy suggestions.
